subjects.title: Civics
subjects.description: The Indian Constitution and political system — its history, institutions, rights, and governing bodies.

subjects.title: Computer Science
subjects.description: The study of computation, algorithms, and the systems that run them.

subSubjects.title: AI Reasoning
subSubjects.description: How intelligent systems convert natural language into structured, symbolic representations — then reason, calculate, and verify answers deterministically instead of guessing.

subSubjects.title: Algorithms
subSubjects.description: Step-by-step methods for solving problems, and how to measure their efficiency.

subSubjects.title: Computer Fundamentals
subSubjects.description: Computer awareness for SSC, banking and police exams: hardware, memory, MS Office, internet and cyber terms.

subSubjects.title: Cybersecurity
subSubjects.description: How systems and users are attacked, and the principles — CIA triad, cryptography, defence in depth — that keep them safe.

subSubjects.title: Databases
subSubjects.description: How structured data is stored, queried, and protected — tables, SQL, schema design, and transactions.

subSubjects.title: Emerging Technologies
subSubjects.description: Cloud platforms, machine learning, and distributed ledgers — the technologies reshaping how software is deployed and used.

subSubjects.title: Networking
subSubjects.description: How computers communicate and exchange data across networks.

subSubjects.title: Operating Systems
subSubjects.description: The software that manages a computer's hardware, processes, and resources.

subSubjects.title: Programming
subSubjects.description: Writing instructions that tell computers what to do.

subSubjects.title: Software Engineering
subSubjects.description: How large software is planned, built, tested, and maintained — process models, requirements, and quality assurance.

subSubjects.title: Web Development
subSubjects.description: How the web works and how pages are built — HTML structure, CSS layout, and JavaScript interactivity.

subjects.title: Economics
subjects.description: How individuals, businesses, and societies allocate scarce resources.

subjects.title: General Knowledge
subjects.description: Static GK for competitive exams — symbols, firsts, states, capitals, awards, sports, books, days, culture, and inventions.

subSubjects.title: Art and Culture
subSubjects.description: India's classical and folk dances, its two classical music systems, and its painting schools.

subSubjects.title: Awards and Honours
subSubjects.description: India's civilian, gallantry and national awards, and the Nobel with the world's big prizes.

subSubjects.title: Books and Authors
subSubjects.description: The exam-staple books — from the Vedas and epics to modern Indian and world classics.

subSubjects.title: Haryana GK
subSubjects.description: Haryana history, geography, districts, economy, culture, places, personalities, sports and schemes for HSSC CET, Haryana Police and state exams.

subSubjects.title: Important Days
subSubjects.description: The national and international days every exam expects you to know.

subSubjects.title: India GK
subSubjects.description: National symbols, famous firsts, states and union territories, and city nicknames.

subSubjects.title: Science GK
subSubjects.description: Who invented or discovered what — the rapid-fire science facts of the GK paper.

subSubjects.title: Sports GK
subSubjects.description: The Olympics and multi-sport events, then terms, trophies and venues across games.

subSubjects.title: World GK
subSubjects.description: Countries, capitals and currencies, plus the major international organizations.

subjects.title: Geography
subjects.description: The study of places, landscapes, and how people interact with them.

subjects.title: History
subjects.description: The study of past events and how they shaped the present.

subjects.title: Languages
subjects.description: Learn the script, grammar, and structure of world languages.

subSubjects.title: English
subSubjects.description: Learn English grammar — sentence structure, tenses, parts of speech, and vocabulary building.

subSubjects.title: Hindi
subSubjects.description: Learn Hindi grammar and structure, starting from the Devanagari script and the Hindi alphabet (varnmala).

subjects.title: Mathematics
subjects.description: The study of numbers, structures, patterns, and change.

subSubjects.title: Algebra
subSubjects.description: Working with symbols and variables, and the rules for manipulating them.

subSubjects.title: Calculus
subSubjects.description: The mathematics of change, motion, and accumulation.

subSubjects.title: Geometry
subSubjects.description: The study of shapes, sizes, angles, and the properties of space.

subSubjects.title: Numbers
subSubjects.description: What numbers are, the main number families, and place value — the foundation everything else in mathematics builds on.

subSubjects.title: Statistics
subSubjects.description: Collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data.

subjects.title: Philosophy
subjects.description: Fundamental questions about knowledge, existence, and ethics.

subjects.title: Reasoning
subjects.description: Logical and verbal reasoning for competitive exams — organized by topic: blood relations, clock and direction problems, coding-decoding, series, syllogism, seating arrangement, analogy/classification, counting of figures, dice reasoning, and sentence rearrangement.

subSubjects.title: Analogy & Classification
subSubjects.description: Word/number analogy and odd-one-out classification — a quick primer plus separate in-depth guides for each.

subSubjects.title: Blood Relation
subSubjects.description: Family-tree and relationship reasoning, in 4 parts.

subSubjects.title: Calendar
subSubjects.description: Odd days, leap-year cycles, and day-of-week puzzles — finding which weekday any date falls on.

subSubjects.title: Clock Reasoning
subSubjects.description: Clock angle, hand-overlap, and time-based reasoning, in 10 parts.

subSubjects.title: Coding-Decoding
subSubjects.description: Letter-shift, substitution, number, and matrix coding — from a quick primer to a full 22-part in-depth guide.

subSubjects.title: Counting of Figures
subSubjects.description: Systematically counting triangles, squares, and other figures hidden in a composite diagram, in 12 parts.

subSubjects.title: Data Sufficiency
subSubjects.description: Deciding whether given data is enough to answer — in arithmetic and in reasoning puzzles, without solving everything.

subSubjects.title: Dice Reasoning
subSubjects.description: Standard and non-standard dice — opposite faces, rotations, and open-cube nets, in 10 parts.

subSubjects.title: Directions & Distance
subSubjects.description: Direction-sense and distance/displacement reasoning, in 10 parts.

subSubjects.title: Input-Output
subSubjects.description: Machine-input puzzles: decoding the rearrangement rule from snapshots and predicting later steps.

subSubjects.title: Mathematical Operations
subSubjects.description: Coded BODMAS: sign substitutions, interchange of signs and numbers, and equation repair.

subSubjects.title: Non-Verbal Reasoning
subSubjects.description: Picture-based logic: mirror and water images, paper folding and cutting, embedded and completed figures.

subSubjects.title: Ranking and Order
subSubjects.description: Position-based reasoning: ranks from ends, between-counts, comparison chains, and order puzzles.

subSubjects.title: Seating Arrangement
subSubjects.description: Linear, circular, and double-row seating arrangement puzzles.

subSubjects.title: Sentence Rearrangement
subSubjects.description: Reordering jumbled sentence parts into a coherent paragraph.

subSubjects.title: Number & Alphabet Series
subSubjects.description: Number series, alphabet series, and mixed series pattern-detection.

subSubjects.title: Syllogism
subSubjects.description: Statement-and-conclusion logic using the four A/E/I/O statement types.

subSubjects.title: Verbal Reasoning
subSubjects.description: Statement-based reasoning for competitive exams — assumptions, conclusions, cause and effect, and course of action.

subjects.title: Science
subjects.description: Explore the natural world through scientific knowledge.

subSubjects.title: Biology
subSubjects.description: The study of living organisms and life processes.

subSubjects.title: Chemistry
subSubjects.description: The study of matter, its properties, and how it changes.

subSubjects.title: Physics
subSubjects.description: Study matter, energy, motion, forces and the laws of nature.
